privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.section1_content: Mannschaft (hereinafter "the Company") is committed to protecting your personal information. This Privacy Policy ("the Policy") governs the handling of personal information in connection with the team management platform "Mannschaft" ("the Service"). Your consent to this Policy is required to use the Service.
privacy.section2_content:
We collect the following personal information from you.

[Account Registration]
- Email address
- First and last name, display name (nickname)
- Date of birth (for age verification and minor protection)
- Postal code and country of residence (for regional services and location-targeted advertising)
- Password (stored as a bcrypt hash; never stored in plain text)

[Profile & Activity]
- Profile photo / avatar
- Teams, organizations, and sports types you belong to
- Schedules, shifts, and attendance records
- Messages, comments, and other posted content

[System Information]
- IP address, device info, and browser info
- Login history, operation logs, and pages visited
- Cookies and session data

[Payment Information]
- Payments are processed by Stripe, Inc. We do not store raw payment data such as card numbers or CVV.
privacy.section3_content:
We use the personal information we collect for the following purposes:

1. Providing, operating, maintaining, and improving the Service
2. User authentication and account management
3. Customer support and inquiry handling
4. Notifications about important updates and service changes
5. Legal compliance and prevention of unauthorized use or security breaches
6. Advertising (see Article 4): Delivering location- and attribute-targeted ads using postal code, date of birth, and group affiliations
7. Aggregation & analysis (see Article 5): Statistical analysis, service improvement, and business reporting in non-personally identifiable form

We will not use your information for any purpose beyond the above.
privacy.section4_content:
Some features of the Service are provided free of charge through advertising revenue. We may use your information in the following ways when delivering ads:

[Types of Targeted Advertising]
- Location targeting (postal code, prefecture): e.g., ads for nearby sports shops
- Attribute targeting (age group, sport type, team size): e.g., equipment relevant to your sport
- Contextual targeting (content of the page you are viewing): e.g., sports-related ads on the schedule page

[What We Do NOT Do]
- Sell personal information directly (we do not sell your name, email, etc. to advertisers)
- Provide detailed individual behavioral profiles to advertisers
- Deliver ads based on sensitive information (health, religion, political views, etc.)
- Target users under 18 with behavioral ads (see Article 13)

[Opt-Out]
You can opt out of targeted advertising in Account Settings (Settings › Privacy). After opting out, only general (non-targeted) ads will be displayed.
privacy.section5_title: Article 5: Aggregated Data Analysis & External Use
privacy.section5_content:
We may use aggregated and anonymized data—data from which no individual can be identified—for the following purposes:
- Analyzing usage trends and improving features
- Creating and publishing industry reports and statistics
- Measuring and improving ad effectiveness
- Business reporting for investors and partners

[Conditions for Sharing Aggregated Data Externally]
- Recipients are contractually prohibited from re-identifying individuals
- The purpose is limited to research and statistics in the sports/community field
- Data that may be cross-referenced with personal information requires your consent (Japanese Act on the Protection of Personal Information, 2022 amendment)

[What We Explicitly Do NOT Do]
- Sell personal information (we do not sell names, emails, phone numbers, or precise location data for monetary consideration)
- Sell individually identifiable behavioral profiles or scoring data
privacy.section6_title: Article 6: Third-Party Disclosure of Personal Information
privacy.section6_content:
Except for the aggregated data described in Article 5, we do not disclose your personal information to third parties except in the following cases:

- When required by law (e.g., lawful requests from investigative authorities)
- When necessary to protect the life, body, or property of you or a third party
- When necessary for public health or the healthy development of children
- When necessary for a government body or local authority to carry out duties prescribed by law
- When you have given explicit consent
privacy.section7_content:
We may entrust the processing of personal information to the following providers for the purpose of delivering the Service. All providers are required to meet our personal information protection standards.

- Infrastructure & Storage: Amazon Web Services, Inc. (USA) - Servers and data storage
- CDN & Security: Cloudflare, Inc. (USA) - Speed optimization and DDoS protection
- Payment Processing: Stripe, Inc. (USA) - Membership fees and billing
- Email Delivery: Amazon Simple Email Service (USA) - Authentication emails and notifications
privacy.section8_content:
[Types of Cookies]
- Essential Cookies (login session maintenance, CSRF protection): Cannot be disabled (disabling them will prevent login)
- Functional Cookies (saving preferences such as dark mode): Manageable from Account Settings
- Advertising Cookies (frequency control and effectiveness measurement for targeted ads): Can be opted out via Account Settings (Settings › Privacy) or browser settings

For users in the EU/EEA, we obtain consent for non-essential cookies on first access.

[Access Logs]
We retain IP addresses, access timestamps, and operation logs for up to 90 days for security monitoring and incident response.
privacy.section9_content:
To maintain service quality, provide customer support, and investigate unauthorized use, authorized system administrators may operate the Service on behalf of your account.

[Conditions]
1. Limited purpose: Only for customer support, technical investigation, and legal compliance checks
2. Limited personnel: Only system administrators with explicit authorization
3. Audit logging: All access is logged with the operator, purpose, reason, and timestamp
4. Minimum necessary: Access is limited to the minimum scope required to achieve the purpose

This feature is a standard support practice used by major SaaS platforms such as Zendesk and Shopify.
privacy.section10_content:
We implement the following technical and organizational measures:

- Encrypted communications (TLS/HTTPS)
- bcrypt password hashing (no plain-text storage)
- Role-based access control (RBAC)
- Multi-factor authentication (SMS, TOTP, Passkey/WebAuthn)
- Regular vulnerability scanning of dependencies

In the event of a personal information breach, we will promptly notify you and the relevant supervisory authority.
privacy.section11_content:
- Access & Correction: You can review and update your personal information in Account Settings (/settings/profile)
- Data Portability: You can request a data export from Account Settings
- Withdrawal & Deletion: Upon withdrawal, we will erase your personal information within 30 days as required by GDPR Art. 17. Data required to be retained by law and anonymized aggregate data may be kept
- Advertising Opt-Out: See Article 4

Users in the EU/EEA may also exercise rights under GDPR Art. 15-22 (restriction of processing, right to object, etc.).
privacy.section12_content:
The Service uses AWS, Cloudflare, and other providers headquartered in the United States, so your personal information may be transferred to and stored outside Japan.

For data of EU/EEA residents, transfers are made under Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) pursuant to GDPR Art. 46, or other appropriate safeguards.
privacy.section13_content:
The Service is intended for users aged 18 and over in accordance with our Terms of Service.

- We do not deliver targeted advertising to users under 18
- If we learn that a user is under 18, we will suspend their account and promptly delete the personal information collected
- Date of birth collected at registration is used solely for age verification; only age groups (e.g., 20s, 30s) are used for ad targeting
privacy.section14_content:
We may update this Policy from time to time in response to legal changes or service updates.

- Material changes (new purposes, new data collection, new third-party sharing, etc.) will be notified in advance via in-service notice or email
- Minor changes will be indicated by updating the "Last Updated" date on this page
- Your continued use of the Service after any revision constitutes your acceptance of the updated Policy
privacy.section15_content: For inquiries about personal information handling, advertising opt-out, or to exercise your rights, please contact us through the in-service inquiry form. We may ask you to provide your registered email address for identity verification.
